name: CARICOM Skills Certificate (Certificate of Recognition of CARICOM Skills Qualification)

requirements.blocker_text: National of a CARICOM member state.

Falls into one of CARICOM's recognized skilled categories: university graduates, associate degree holders, teachers, registered nurses, artisans/household domestics (CVQ Level 2+), artistes/musicians/sportspersons actively earning a living in their field, media workers, agricultural workers, or private security officers. Aviation personnel definitions were still 'pending finalization' as of the CARICOM Secretariat's December 2025 definitions document.

evidence_required.document: Qualification documentation for the relevant skilled category

outcome.duration_length: certificate does not expire but is updated every 10 years alongside passport renewal

sources.title: Ministry of Labour and Social Security (MLSS), Jamaica -- CARICOM Skills Certificate: implements the Caribbean Community (Free Movement of Skilled Persons) Act, 1997, applications made to MLSS (not PICA); grants free movement to work in Jamaica without a work permit, no employer sponsorship or labour market test required; fees JMD 2,000 (application) + 8,000 (certificate) + 3,000 (replacement)

CARICOM Secretariat -- Definitions of Categories of Skilled Nationals, as at December 2025: lists all recognized skilled categories region-wide, including two recently added (agricultural workers, private security officers) and one still pending finalization (aviation personnel)

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Jamaica). STATUS: DRAFT -- downgraded from an initial published draft after validation: the nationality requirement (jmcs_caricom_national) is tier-1 MLSS sourced, but the recognized-skilled-category list (jmcs_skilled_category) rests on the CARICOM Secretariat's own definitions document, which is tier-2 (intergovernmental), not tier-1. Per this dataset's rule that every hard requirement in a published route must cite tier-1, this file stays draft until a tier-1 MLSS or PICA source enumerating the recognized categories directly is found. GENUINELY DISTINCTIVE ROUTE, THE MARQUEE FINDING FOR THIS FILE: this is regional free-movement, not ordinary immigration -- no employer sponsorship, no labour market test, no per-duration fee scaling, and the certificate effectively never expires (just gets refreshed alongside passport renewal). Modeled as category 'work_independent' since it grants the right to work without being tied to a specific employer or investment structure, though it functions more like a regional citizenship-adjacent mobility right than a conventional freelance permit. Holders can use this certificate as supporting documentation toward 'Unconditional Landing' (Jamaica's term for permanent residence, see jm_permanent_residence.json) -- reflected here as pr_after_months=0, meaning the certificate itself can support an immediate PR application rather than requiring additional waiting time, though PR itself still requires a separate application. This is Jamaica's implementation of the CSME (Caribbean Community Single Market and Economy) skilled-persons free-movement regime that other CARICOM Jamaica-adjacent countries in this dataset (e.g. Grenada, St Kitts and Nevis, St Lucia, St Vincent and the Grenadines, if built) would be expected to mirror in their own immigration systems.
